record.label: Coherent H4+alpha and L4 contribution
record.summary: The exact A2_THIRD_ONLY source (SHA-256 43ee43386c450b33...) was independently audited as the intended no-CP4, no-H4/L4, CP3+H3+Gaussian+L3+one-half-L3-squared ablation with no source bug. It nevertheless failed its preregistered target-free scientific gate: the official-He width-32 fixture became nonfinite first at covariance reset 3 and K21 reset 4 while byte-identical V4 remained finite. Its finite width-8 and width-64 outputs also disagreed catastrophically with V4 (final MSE 3.7206637e6 and 4.8400454e11). The registered exact resource-projection gate also failed, so no literal production meter, target/raw-MSE access, package, or submission was permitted. This closes only these exact A2 bytes; it does not supply the originally planned target-score contrast or close every materially different coherent quartic construction.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed for the exact frozen A2_THIRD_ONLY form by its registered official-He finiteness and resource-projection failures. Any materially different successor requires new bytes and a new preregistration; this receipt authorizes negative target-free evidence only.
